glosses: subject matter, the practical realities and collected knowledge regarding the topic at hand
matter, material (as opposed to the form, or the immaterial)

examples.text: Die Wissenschaftler wissen nicht, woraus die dunkle Materie besteht.
examples.en: Scientists don't know what dark matter is made of.

examples.text: Die Wissenschaftler glauben, daß es im jungen Universum gleich viel Materie und Antimaterie gab.
examples.en: Scientists believe that there were equal amounts of matter and antimatter in the early universe.

examples.text: Unsere Galaxis, die Milchstraße, enthält anscheinend dunkle Materie.
examples.en: Our galaxy, the Milky Way, apparently contains dark matter.

examples.text: Die Wissenschaftler glauben, daß es im jungen Universum gleich viel Materie wie Antimaterie gab.
examples.en: Scientists believe that there were equal amounts of matter and antimatter in the early universe.
